name: step_toward_target_with_delay
description: Sets bit 2 of the global status word and calls a helper with a fixed value, then compares two stored values. When they differ it sets or clears the direction bit, repeats a step call once per unit of difference with a delay call after, and finally writes a word into a record and passes the record to a helper.

name: repeat_step_by_difference
description: Sets the direction bit of the global status word, then calls a step helper once for each unit of difference between two stored values, followed by a delay call. It writes a word into a record and passes that record to a helper.

name: wait_then_store_record_word
description: Calls a delay helper with a fixed value, writes a word taken from the second parameter into a record, and passes the record to a helper.

name: poll_custom_status_with_timeout
description: Writes a value from a record to a custom chip register, clears an interrupt request bit, and calls a helper. If the status flag is clear it polls an input status register with a countdown, returning 22 on timeout, 25 when the flag is set, and 0 when the poll succeeds.

name: poll_slot_until_flag_set
description: Loops over a counter, and when a flag bit in the frame is set it clears a word in the record, calls a helper, and returns the result code, which is 25 when the global flag bit is set. It returns 22 when the counter runs out.

name: consume_pending_flag_and_run
description: Returns 0 when the flag byte at the start of the record is clear. Otherwise it clears the flag, calls a helper twice, and returns the result of the second call.

name: clear_record_flag_and_notify
description: Clears the flag byte in the record named by the parameter, then passes that record to a helper twice.

name: enable_interrupt_bits
description: Writes the parameter, with the top two bits set, to the custom chip interrupt enable register so that the given interrupt sources and the master interrupt enable are switched on.

name: search_bit_packed_code_word
description: Scans a bit-packed table of 16-bit words from a starting bit position, looking for a code equal to the first parameter within a word-count limit. It returns the matching bit position and code, or a negative marker when the limit is reached without a match.

name: skip_words_then_match_codeword
description: Advances the stream past a stored number of words, then reads the next word and compares it with a stored key, returning the bit position on a match. Otherwise it shifts in further words within a limit and returns a negative marker when the limit runs out.

name: match_codeword_in_bitstream
description: Reads the next word from a stream, compares it with a stored key, and returns the bit position on a match. Otherwise it shifts in further words up to a word limit, returning a negative marker when no match is found.

name: advance_stream_and_match_seed
description: Advances the stream by one word, then shifts a seed value left by a stored bit count and combines it with new words. It returns the bit position when the top word matches a stored key, or a negative marker at the limit.

name: shift_seed_and_match_codeword
description: Shifts a seed value by a stored bit count combined with the current word, then tests the top word against a stored key. It returns the position on a match or a negative marker when the word limit is reached.

name: shift_bits_until_codeword_matches
description: Shifts an accumulator one bit at a time, counting bit positions, and takes in a new stream word after every sixteen shifts. It returns the bit position once the top word equals a stored key, or a negative marker when the word limit is reached.

name: accumulate_words_until_codeword_matches
description: Repeatedly adds the next stream word to an accumulator and shifts it left one bit per step, returning the bit position when the top word equals a stored key. It returns a negative marker if the word count reaches its limit first.

name: allocate_and_verify_block_load
description: Allocates a 28400-byte buffer and runs a setup sequence on it, then calls a routine twice and checks the difference between the returned offsets against a threshold. It returns 1 if allocation fails, 2 or 3 if either call fails, 4 if the size check fails, and frees the buffer and returns 0 on success.

name: reload_block_and_check_size
description: Runs the same setup sequence on an existing buffer, calls a routine twice to get two offsets, and checks their difference against a threshold. It returns 2 or 3 if either call fails and 4 if the size check fails, and frees the buffer and returns 0 on success.

name: check_second_block_read_size
description: Calls a routine for a second time on the buffer, computes the difference from a stored offset, and checks it against a threshold. It returns 3 if the call fails, frees the buffer and returns 0 when the check passes, and returns 4 otherwise.

name: check_block_size_and_free
description: Computes the difference between two stored offsets, subtracts a fixed threshold, and frees the buffer and returns 0 when the result is within range. Otherwise it returns 4.

name: update_object_state_by_code
description: Reads a state code from the object record and dispatches to one of several branches that adjust its position and timing fields and call helper routines. One step swaps two table entries and exchanges a block of longwords.

name: swap_table_entries_and_update
description: Decrements a stored index and, when it is in range and differs from a stored value, swaps two bytes in a table and exchanges a 16-longword block. It then sets timer fields and runs the common object state update.

name: dispatch_object_state_update
description: Runs the common per-object update, which sets timer and status fields in the record and dispatches on a state code to one of several branches. Those branches write values into the object's data block and call helper routines.

name: set_timer_field_and_call
description: Sets a fixed timer byte in the record and calls a helper.

name: run_state_update_when_clear
description: Calls two helpers, then runs the common object state update when the zero condition is clear, and otherwise returns without updating.

name: decrement_bcd_field_reset_timer
description: Decrements a binary-coded decimal counter in the record using decimal adjustment when it is nonzero, resets another field to ten, and then runs the common object state update.

name: parse_input_codes_into_state
description: Reads input codes from a stream until a terminator and stores them in a slot range of the record. When a specific code pair arrives it sets a mask flag and updates a counter, and it sets a timer field in the record.

name: parse_input_codes_if_flag
description: Conditionally enters an input-code parser that reads codes until a terminator and stores them in a slot range of the record. When a specific code pair matches, it updates a counter and a flag mask in the record.

name: parse_input_codes_from_check
description: Runs a condition check and then enters the input-code parser, which reads codes into a slot range and updates a counter and flag mask in the record when a specific code pair matches.

name: parse_command_input_codes
description: Reads input codes into a slot range of the record and, when a specific code pair matches, updates a counter and flag mask. It references a text label with a command prefix, and the routine is one of several entry points into the same parser.

name: parse_single_input_code
description: Handles one input code already held in a register by storing it in the next key slot. It matches code pairs to update a counter and flag mask in the record.

name: handle_special_input_codes
description: Checks several specific code pairs: one sets a per-record flag, one ORs a mask bit into a field, one decrements a binary-coded decimal counter, and one toggles a field between two fixed values. It then runs the common object update.

name: or_mask_then_decrement_marker
description: For one code pair it ORs a mask bit into a record field, then decrements a binary-coded decimal counter and copies a table marker into the record when it matches, clearing the table entry. It then runs the common object update.

name: decrement_bcd_copy_marker
description: Decrements a binary-coded decimal counter, then copies a table entry into the record and clears it when that entry equals a fixed marker. It then runs the common object update.

name: check_available_memory_then_update
description: When the input code is four, checks available memory and runs a short count loop, then runs the common object update.

name: handle_code_pairs_and_toggle
description: Handles two code pairs: one calls a helper after checking a stored marker, and the other toggles a record field between two fixed values when a flag bit is set. It then runs the common object update.

name: toggle_field_on_code_match
description: Toggles a record field between two fixed values when a specific input code and flag bits match, then runs the common object update.

name: run_object_update_from_timer
description: Enters the common object update after its timer setup, which sets timer fields and dispatches on a state code to several branches.

name: match_directional_input_code
description: Reads input codes and, when one matches a group of directional codes, updates a counter and flag mask in the record. It references a text label with a direction prefix.

name: match_four_code_group
description: Matches an input code against a group of four codes and, when it matches, updates a counter and flag mask in the record. It references text labels for the four codes.

name: match_code_and_update_counter
description: Stores the incoming code in the record, checks a flag mask, and when the code and counter match it advances the counter and runs a short delay.

name: advance_counter_and_write_pattern
description: When two stored indices match, increments a counter and writes a four-step byte pattern to a buffer, then runs the common object update.

name: advance_index_write_pattern
description: When the input code equals a stored index, advances that index and writes the same byte pattern to a buffer four times, then runs the common object update.

name: idle_loop_after_global_check
description: Checks a global value against a fixed marker, calls a helper on the matching branch, and then loops forever without returning.

name: call_helper_then_loop_forever
description: Calls a helper and then enters an endless loop, so the routine never returns.

name: stub_endless_loop
description: Contains only an endless loop that calls a helper on each pass, so it never returns.

name: set_flag_bits_on_marker
description: When a record byte equals a fixed value, ORs a value read from the input into the record flag byte, then runs the common object update.

name: or_input_bits_into_flags
description: Reads a value from the input, ORs it into a record flag byte, and runs the common object update.

name: set_flag_on_specific_codes
description: Checks two code pairs against the record's state bytes and sets a flag byte in the record for each match, then runs the common object update.

name: set_flag_code_pair_alt
description: Sets a flag byte in the record for a matching code pair, using the same checks as its neighbouring routine, then runs the common object update.

name: set_flag_and_update
description: Sets a record flag byte to one and runs the common object update.

name: set_flag_matching_pair
description: When two state bytes equal a fixed code pair, sets a flag byte in the record, then runs the common object update.

name: set_flag_on_second_byte
description: When the second state byte equals a fixed value, sets a record flag byte, then runs the common object update.

name: set_secondary_flag_and_update
description: Sets a secondary record flag byte to one and runs the common object update.

name: enter_common_object_update
description: Enters the common object update, which checks the state bytes and dispatches to the matching branch.

name: decrement_bcd_directional_marker
description: When a computed comparison leaves the flag clear, decrements a binary-coded decimal counter and copies a table marker into the record when it matches, clearing the table entry. It references a text label with a direction prefix, then runs the common object update.

name: decrement_bcd_marker_from_input
description: Stores the input value as a table index, decrements a binary-coded decimal counter, and copies the table marker into the record when it matches, clearing the table entry.

name: decrement_bcd_from_input_index
description: Decrements a binary-coded decimal counter from the input value and copies a table marker into the record when the indexed entry matches, clearing that entry.

name: copy_table_marker_into_record
description: Copies a table entry selected by an input value into the record and clears the table entry, then runs the common object update.

name: check_state_pair_then_update
description: When the state bytes equal a fixed pair and a counter has a fixed value, calls a routine, then runs the common object update.

name: enter_common_update_directly
description: Enters the common object update without any preceding checks.

name: decrement_bcd_field_if_clear
description: When the test leaves the flag clear, decrements a binary-coded decimal field in the record if it is nonzero, then runs the common object update.

name: decrement_bcd_field_then_update
description: Decrements a binary-coded decimal field in the record when it is nonzero, then runs the common object update.

name: reset_record_words_and_update
description: Computes a binary-coded decimal value from the input and stores it in a record field, clears two record words, saves and restores a global value around a fixed write, then runs the common object update.

name: clear_record_words_and_update
description: Clears two record words, saves a global value, writes a fixed value to that global and restores it, then runs the common object update.

name: branch_on_state_then_update
description: Chooses one of two sets of calls based on a state byte, then runs the common object update.

name: call_pair_then_update
description: Calls two routines and then enters the common object update.

name: save_record_position_and_run
description: Saves a word and two bytes from the record into fixed saved fields, then calls five routines and returns.

name: call_five_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls five routines in sequence and returns.

name: call_four_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls four routines in sequence and returns.

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns.

name: write_fixed_byte_sequence
description: Writes a fixed sequence of nine values in turn to the same shared byte and returns.

name: check_ready_count_and_clear
description: Sets a state flag and, when a test result is clear and a value is under five, stores that value minus one in a counter and clears the flag before calling routines. It references a ready text prompt.

name: clear_state_flag_and_update
description: Clears a state flag, calls a set of routines, and then runs the common object update.

name: store_count_and_read_codes
description: When the input is four or less, stores it decremented as a counter and clears a state flag, then reads input codes until one falls in a range and records it in a table.

name: read_code_store_table_entry
description: Reads input codes until one falls in a range, then stores a derived value in a table entry of the record. It references a text label with a weapon prefix.

name: run_common_update_from_entry
description: Enters the common object update from an alternate entry point after two calls.

name: enter_update_after_setup
description: Enters the common object update from an alternate entry point after a short setup sequence.

name: search_eleven_entry_table
description: Searches up to eleven bytes of a table for the value held in a record byte, then returns without changing any state.

name: run_shared_object_update_b
description: Runs the start of the common object update from the second code segment, checking the state bytes before dispatching.

name: restore_saved_position_state
description: Restores the object's two state bytes from saved fields, sets a field to 255 and clears the state code, then calls a long sequence of routines and sets a global flag to one.

name: tick_timer_and_reset_fields
description: Sets two timer bytes in the record to a fixed value, then decrements a counter in the record or calls two routines, depending on a range test on another field.

name: check_state_code_match
description: Reads a state code from the record and compares it with a fixed value and a global byte. The matching branch is empty, so the routine has no visible effect.

name: tick_countdown_fields
description: When the state code is zero, decrements two countdown bytes in the record. When the first reaches zero it reloads it with 12 and stores a result in a global, and it handles the second countdown in the same way.

name: increment_and_clamp_index
description: Increments the input byte and, when the result exceeds a fixed limit, replaces it with a lower fixed value.

name: reset_timer_bytes_and_run
description: Sets one record byte to 8, clears another, then calls four routines and returns.

name: copy_global_block_to_record
description: Chooses a global value, then copies a block of values from a global table into two record bytes in a loop, calling a routine for each pass.

name: copy_global_entries_with_marker
description: Copies entries from a global table into two record bytes in a loop, writing a fixed value to a second record byte on each pass, then sets a record field from a global value.

name: read_value_in_range_offset
description: Reads bytes until one falls within a fixed range, calls two routines, and returns that byte offset by a fixed amount.

name: read_bounded_value_into_field
description: Sets a flag, reads bytes until one falls within a fixed range, clears the flag, and stores that value offset by a fixed amount into a record field.

name: accumulate_bcd_total
description: Adds a record byte to an accumulator once for each pass of a count value, then stores the total in a record field.

name: store_value_under_limit
description: Reads a value and stores it in a record byte when it is below a fixed limit, otherwise calls a routine instead.

name: store_read_value_in_field
description: Reads a value and stores it in a record byte, with no alternate path taken in practice.

name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Calls one routine and returns.

name: store_value_in_second_slot
description: Reads a value and stores it in a second record byte slot.

name: store_value_and_compare_slots
description: Reads a value into one record byte and compares it with two other record bytes, returning early when it is below the first. Otherwise it applies a tie-break comparison on the next pair of bytes.

name: add_bcd_to_indexed_byte
description: Adds the input to a binary-coded decimal byte selected by a table index, stores the adjusted sum, and returns that byte.

name: store_word_into_indexed_bytes
description: Writes the low and high bytes of a word into two record bytes selected by an index.

name: add_bcd_to_indexed_entry
description: Adds the input to a binary-coded decimal byte selected by an index and stores the adjusted sum.

name: set_indexed_bcd_maximum
description: Stores the binary-coded decimal value 99 in a byte selected by an index.

name: count_bcd_down_to_zero
description: Decrements a binary-coded decimal value one step at a time until it reaches zero.

name: count_bcd_up_to_input
description: Stores the input count in a record byte, then increments a binary-coded decimal total once for each count.

name: subtract_bcd_pair_with_borrow
description: Subtracts the input from a two-byte binary-coded decimal value in the record, propagating the borrow into the higher byte.

name: poll_status_code_or_timeout
description: Repeatedly calls a routine and checks a record byte against two fixed codes, giving up after a small retry count and calling a routine instead.

name: call_pair_then_loop_forever
description: Calls two routines and then enters an endless loop, so the routine never returns.

name: save_state_and_run_update
description: Clears the state code, saves the object's two state bytes and a position field into saved fields, then calls a routine. Other state code values take different branches.

name: set_state_code_from_argument
description: Stores a stack argument into the record's state code byte.

name: dispatch_code_byte_to_handlers
description: Stores an input code byte in the record and dispatches on it, handling a code of 64 with a few routine calls and taking other branches for other values.

name: repeat_action_until_flag_clear
description: Loops over a sequence of calls and, on the first pass, runs a group of five routines unless a bit in a record byte is set.

name: check_input_range_no_effect
description: Tests an input byte against zero and a fixed value, with no visible effect in the branch body.

name: copy_position_bytes_to_saved
description: Copies two position bytes from the record into two saved record bytes.

name: restore_saved_position_bytes
description: Copies the saved fields back into the record's two position bytes.

name: set_counter_two_and_call
description: Sets a counter word to two and calls a routine.

name: render_nonzero_entries_in_rows
description: Loops over a short global table and, for each nonzero entry, sets two record position bytes to fixed values, calls routines for the entry, and advances a row byte.

name: scan_slot_rows_for_nonzero
description: Walks a table of 64-byte rows and, for each nonzero row, sets two record position bytes and calls routines, stopping when the row count runs out.

name: output_zero_terminated_string
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string from a global location, calling a routine for each character and advancing a position byte in the record.

name: call_pair_and_advance_position
description: Calls two routines and then advances a position byte in the record.

name: call_and_advance_position
description: Calls one routine and advances a position byte in the record.

name: position_and_output_string
description: Measures a zero-terminated string, sets the record's position bytes from half its length, and then calls a routine for each character.

name: add_bcd_two_byte_total
description: Adds the input to the low byte of a two-byte binary-coded decimal total in the record and adjusts it.

name: set_two_byte_total_maximum
description: Stores the binary-coded decimal value 99 in both bytes of a two-byte total in the record.

name: store_pair_and_loop_state
description: Stores the two input bytes in record fields, then loops on a state code, calling routines on each pass until the state changes.

name: tick_frame_counter_and_reset
description: Decrements a frame counter in the record and, when it reaches zero, resets it to four and processes a second counter.

name: process_input_state_codes
description: Loops over two record state bytes and calls routines when each matches one of several fixed codes, until the loop exits.

name: dispatch_state_code_loop
description: Loops over a record state byte and an input code byte, handling several fixed values with calls to routines.

name: raise_counter_if_below
description: Compares a record counter with an input value and calls a routine when the counter is less than the input.

name: increment_bcd_record_byte
description: Increments a binary-coded decimal byte in the record.

name: test_state_byte_no_effect
description: Calls a routine and tests a record byte against two fixed values, with no visible effect in the branch body.

name: map_code_to_state_offset
description: Stores an input value in a record byte, adjusting it by a fixed offset for particular input codes.

name: subtract_bcd_input_from_pair
description: Subtracts an input value from a two-byte binary-coded decimal value in the record, propagating a borrow from the lower byte.

name: clear_total_and_run_five
description: Clears a two-byte total in the record and calls five routines.

name: tick_timer_and_place_object
description: Counts down a timer byte in the record and, when it reaches zero, resets it to four and sets position bytes from a global value before calling routines.

name: call_routine_on_global_match
description: When a global byte equals both record state bytes, calls a routine.

name: stub_no_operation
description: Contains only a return and does nothing.

name: reset_object_and_start_sequence
description: Sets a record field to 24 and calls routines. When the state code is zero it copies the position bytes into saved fields, clears a byte, and sets a global to two.

name: busy_wait_loop
description: Runs nested countdown loops on a record byte as a timing delay when a state byte is non-negative.

name: reset_object_to_start_state
description: Copies the position bytes into saved fields, clears a byte, sets globals and state fields to fixed starting values, and calls ten routines.

name: restore_saved_state_and_run
description: Calls six routines, then restores the position bytes from saved fields, clears the state code, sets a field to 22, and sets a global to one.

name: copy_field_and_call_two
description: Copies one record field into another record byte and calls two routines.

name: load_position_from_global_table
description: Looks up a value in the global table at an offset from a global value, stores it in both position bytes, then calls four routines.

name: reset_timers_and_check_range
description: Sets two timer bytes in the record to a fixed value, then decrements a counter or calls routines depending on a range test on the state code and a flip flag.

name: scan_table_backward_for_entries
description: When the state code is zero, scans a 32-entry global table backward for nonzero entries and calls routines for each one it finds.

name: match_table_entries_to_position
description: Scans a 32-entry global table for nonzero entries and compares each one with the record's two position bytes, calling routines on matches.

name: store_bounded_relative_offsets
description: Computes two relative offsets from five minus stored values, stores them in the record's position bytes when both are below a fixed bound, and calls routines otherwise.

name: scan_table_by_flag_bits
description: Scans a global table, classifying each entry by its top two bits, and calls routines for matching entries until a non-matching entry stops the scan.

name: check_table_value_range
description: Tests a global table value against a fixed range and, outside it, checks the input code against a set of fixed codes. The visible branch bodies are empty.

name: stub_empty_routine
description: Is an empty routine with no body.

name: compute_offsets_from_table_entry
description: Computes two position offsets from the record's position bytes minus values taken from the global table at an index, combines one with a table byte, and stores them in the record.

name: store_sum_of_two_bytes
description: Stores one returned value in a record field and adds a second returned value to it.

name: find_matching_table_index
description: Scans a 32-entry global table backward for a nonzero entry equal to both record position bytes and returns its index.

name: search_table_back_from_index
description: Scans the global table backward from an input index for a nonzero entry that matches both record position bytes.

name: draw_direction_and_level_labels
description: Sets position bytes and calls routines to output labels, referencing text for compass directions and a level indicator, and stores a value computed from a record byte for display.

name: forward_direction_text_output
description: Calls one routine and returns. Its text references are for compass directions.

name: call_routine_if_field_set
description: Calls a routine, calls another when a record byte is nonzero, then calls one more routine and returns.

name: run_flagged_test_sequence
description: Runs a sequence of routine calls, each guarded by a boolean flag that decides whether the next call is made.

name: apply_inverted_table_mask
description: Stores a table byte selected by an index into the record, then loops over a count combining and inverting the stored bytes.

name: load_eight_byte_glyph_rows
description: Loads an eight-byte table entry selected by an index into consecutive record bytes, the layout of a bitmap glyph.

name: clear_bitplane_column_bits
description: When the character code is a space, computes an inverted mask and clears its bits in the bitplane bytes at the current position, applying the same mask to each bitplane.

name: lookup_bit_shift_table_byte
description: Returns a table byte selected by a record byte offset by a fixed amount and masked to eight entries.

name: load_glyph_bytes_in_range
description: When the input index is within twenty, looks up a glyph entry and, when its value is nonnegative, copies its bytes into record fields. It references a short text string.

name: load_glyph_mask_bytes
description: When the input index is within twenty, loads a mask-table entry selected by its low bits into record fields and stores a sentinel value in a global.

name: compute_wrapped_difference_x
description: Computes the difference between two record bytes and stores it, complementing the stored value when the subtraction borrowed.

name: compute_wrapped_difference_y
description: Computes the difference between two record bytes and stores it, complementing the stored value when the subtraction borrowed.

name: interpolate_between_record_bytes
description: When the first record byte is below the second, steps a value from the first toward the second in half-size increments, storing each step in the record.

name: interpolate_steps_toward_target
description: Steps a record value in half-size increments toward a target byte, storing each step until the target is reached.

name: set_bitplane_pixel_bit
description: Computes a byte offset and bit position in a bitplane from two record values and sets or clears that single bit depending on a global flag.

name: draw_cell_grid_patterns
description: Walks a grid of cells, mapping each cell code to a pattern value and drawing it through a routine until the grid is complete.

name: map_cell_pattern
description: Maps each input cell code to a fixed pattern value and calls a routine to draw it, repeating for each code.

name: map_cell_pattern_b
description: Continues the cell code to pattern mapping chain for the upper range of codes, drawing each cell through a routine.

name: map_cell_pattern_c
description: Continues the cell code to pattern mapping chain from a later range of codes, drawing each cell through a routine.

name: map_cell_pattern_d
description: Continues the cell code to pattern mapping chain for the final range of codes, drawing each cell through a routine.

name: map_cell_pattern_e
description: Continues the cell code to value chain, assigning a fixed value to code 16 and another fixed value to other nonzero codes, then draws the cell through a routine.

name: draw_cell_rows_value
description: Draws cell rows with the current fixed value, looping over the grid positions and calling routines for each row until the cell code runs out.

name: draw_cell_block_at_offset
description: Computes a cell position offset by four from the record's position bytes, then loops drawing cells through routines until a flag stops it.

name: map_code_value_pair
description: Maps input codes to fixed values in a loop and draws each one through routines while a flag is clear.

name: map_code_value_quad
description: Maps codes from a small set to fixed values and draws them through routines in a loop.

name: fill_wrapped_row_value_a
description: Writes a fixed value across row positions that wrap at sixty-four, calling routines to advance the row until the count ends.

name: fill_wrapped_row_value_b
description: Writes a second fixed value across row positions that wrap at sixty-four, calling routines to advance the row until the count ends.

name: fill_wrapped_row_value_c
description: Writes a third fixed value across row positions that wrap at sixty-four, calling routines to advance the row until the count ends.

name: fill_wrapped_row_value_d
description: Writes a fourth fixed value across row positions that wrap at sixty-four, calling routines to advance the row until the count ends.

name: fill_wrapped_row_white
description: Writes an all-ones fixed value across row positions that wrap at sixty-four, calling routines to advance the row until the count ends.

name: fill_wrapped_row_value_e
description: Writes another fixed value across row positions that wrap at sixty-four, calling routines to advance the row until the count ends.

name: call_four_routines_alt
description: Calls four routines in sequence and returns.

name: fill_wrapped_row_low_byte
description: Writes a fixed low-byte value across row positions that wrap at sixty-four, calling routines to advance the row until the count ends.

name: fill_wrapped_row_value_f
description: Writes a further fixed value across row positions that wrap at sixty-four, calling routines to advance the row until the count ends.

name: advance_wrapped_row_position
description: Advances a row position that wraps at sixty-four, calling routines on each step until a count is reached.

name: advance_row_and_swap_buffers
description: Advances a row counter in the record and, when it passes sixty-three, resets it and swaps two stored buffer pointers before calling routines.

name: scan_bytes_and_return_zero
description: Reads a long run of bytes and tests each for a negative value, then returns zero. The test branch body is empty.

name: store_scaled_position_offsets
description: Stores two input bytes in the record and computes two derived bytes by adding each to twice a record position byte.

name: set_globals_and_run_sequence
description: Calls routines, sets two global bytes to fixed values, then makes further calls depending on a flag.

name: stub_return_only_routine
description: Contains only a return in the decompiled output, although the disassembly holds 31 instructions, so no effect is visible from the pseudo-code.

name: find_free_slot_and_open
description: Searches a table of file slots for one that is unused, then passes the slot and the two parameters to a routine that opens the file.

name: forward_to_slot_open
description: Checks whether the slot pointer is the end of the table, then calls the open routine with the two parameters and the slot.

name: forward_to_open_routine
description: Calls the open routine with two parameters and a slot, then returns.

name: parse_file_mode_string
description: Reads a two-character mode string, setting a binary flag when the second character is b and choosing an access mode from the first character, then passes the result to a routine.

name: parse_write_mode_flags
description: Reads a mode string and sets open-flag bits for write mode and an optional update marker.

name: open_file_with_access_flags
description: Opens a file with a fixed set of access and permission values, returns zero on failure, and otherwise repositions the handle before returning it.

name: select_open_mode_and_check
description: Repositions the file handle, chooses one of two open-mode values depending on a flag, and checks a lookup result.

name: mark_handle_entry_state
description: Looks up a handle table entry and updates its state field, setting a bit when a table flag is nonzero.

name: open_file_with_mode_flags
description: Chooses an open-mode value from a flag, calls a routine to open the file with the combined flags, and returns zero when the open fails.

name: open_handle_for_mode
description: Opens a file with the given parameters, returns zero when the open fails, and otherwise chooses a mode value from a flag before returning the handle entry.
